tools.name: add_labor_signal
tools.description: Records one absence or extra shift in revisioned local roster state and clears a current labor preview. The working order stays unchanged. Returns signalId, kind, staffId, revision, and laborPreviewInvalidated.

inputSchema.description: A roster signal tied to a specific shared revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required shared revision from get_labor_plan or the previous mutation result.

kind.description: Roster change represented by an absence or an added shift.

staffId.description: Stable roster or on-call staff identifier from get_labor_plan.

daypart.description: Daypart for kind extra_shift. Omit for kind absence.

hours.description: Whole scheduled hours for kind extra_shift. Omit for kind absence.

note.description: Human-authored detail stored with the roster signal.

tools.name: add_local_signal
tools.description: Stores one local booking, event cancellation, or operator note in revisioned local state without calculating or previewing the order. Handoff receipts are a separate record. Returns signalId, kind, label, revision, and previewBecameStale.

inputSchema.description: A local signal write tied to a specific review revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required review revision from get_order_context or the previous mutation result.

kind.description: Signal kind. Operator notes are operational facts in the order review.

label.description: Short human-authored label stored in the signals panel.

covers.description: Guest count for a booking signal.

occurredAt.description: Local date or time associated with the signal.

note.description: Human-authored detail stored with the signal.

tools.name: add_shift_note
tools.description: Adds a local note to the active service-day record without changing either preview. Returns noteId and revision.

inputSchema.description: A human-authored note tied to a shared revision and optional section.

expectedRevision.description: Required shared revision from get_shift_log or the previous mutation result.

text.description: Shift note text stored in this browser.

tools.name: create_labor_preview
tools.description: Creates and renders a revisioned staffing preview from the working order and roster signals. The adopted roster stays unchanged. Returns previewId, revision, dayparts with gaps, reasons, and actions, plus scheduled and required totals.

inputSchema.description: A staffing preview tied to a specific shared revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required shared revision from get_labor_plan or the previous mutation result.

note.description: Short human-authored reason stored with the preview activity.

tools.name: create_order_preview
tools.description: Creates and renders a revisioned supplier-order preview from current signals and pins. The saved order and adoption status remain unchanged. Returns previewId, revision, covers and laborHours before and after, each line's before, after, delta, and reason, cost before and after, and warnings.

inputSchema.description: A supplier-order preview tied to a specific review revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required review revision from get_order_context or the previous mutation result.

rationale.description: Short reason stored with the preview.

tools.name: get_labor_plan
tools.description: Reads service-day staffing against the covers in the working order. Returns presetId, forecastCovers, requiredTotal, dayparts with required, scheduled, gap, and shifts, onCall, signals, laborPreviewId, and revision.

tools.name: get_line_detail
tools.description: Reads the calculation and current decision for one stock line in the order review. Returns item, unit, caseSize, usagePerCover, onHand, expiring, usable, inTransit, safety, safetyRationale, demand, need, calculatedCases, pinnedCases, currentReason, and expiringShare.

inputSchema.description: A stock line selected by its stable SKU identifier.

tools.name: get_order_context
tools.description: Reads the current restaurant supplier-order review. Returns guide, presetId, store, serviceDate, cutoffAt, deliveryAt, forecast, draft, lines, focusedSkuId, pins, signals, previewId, and revision.

tools.name: get_shift_log
tools.description: Reads the newest recorded actions for the active service day, optionally filtered by section. Returns presetId, serviceDate, entries with id, time, section, actor, tool, and summary, plus total and revision.

inputSchema.description: Optional section filter and result limit for the current shift record.

section.description: Optional section filter for recorded actions.

limit.description: Maximum number of newest entries returned, from 1 to 200.

tools.name: get_stock_status
tools.description: Reads current counts and the weekly waste ledger for the Stock section. Returns presetId; items with onHand, expiring, lastCountedAt, wasteWeekQty, and wasteWeekCost; totals with wasteWeekCost, byReason, and topReason; orderPreviewStale; and revision.

tools.name: log_waste
tools.description: Adds one local waste entry, reduces the item's on-hand stock, and invalidates an older order preview. Returns entryId, cost, newOnHand, newExpiring, weekTotal, revision, and orderPreviewInvalidated.

inputSchema.description: A waste record tied to a specific shared revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required shared revision from get_stock_status or the previous mutation result.

quantity.description: Wasted quantity in the item's unit.

reason.description: Operational reason for the waste entry.

note.description: Human-authored detail stored with the waste entry.

tools.name: open_section
tools.description: Moves the manager to a different order, stock, labor, or shift-log section while preserving store and revision. It is redundant if the destination section's tools are already available. Returns section, toolNames registered on the destination, and revision.

inputSchema.description: A destination in the shared shift operations desk.

section.description: Destination section in the shift operations desk.

tools.name: record_stock_count
tools.description: Records on-hand and expiring stock for one item in revisioned local state and invalidates an older order preview. Returns skuId, previous and current counts, revision, and orderPreviewInvalidated.

inputSchema.description: A shelf count tied to a specific shared revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required shared revision from get_stock_status or the previous mutation result.

onHand.description: Physical on-hand quantity in the item's unit.

expiring.description: Quantity within onHand that expires before service.

tools.name: save_handoff_receipt
tools.description: Stores a manager handoff summary as a local browser receipt. Operator notes are operational facts in the order review; handoff receipts are shift records. Returns receiptId, presetId, revision, and confirmation that the result stayed in this browser.

inputSchema.description: A local handoff receipt tied to a specific review revision.

expectedRevision.description: Required review revision from get_order_context or the previous mutation result.

managerSummary.description: Human-authored handoff summary stored in the local receipt.
